scope: actual standalone Cell CPU, frozen Raytrace, four workers; not native egglog
limits: Task residence includes OS descheduling. Pool calls include useful work. No-task gaps include dispatch, wakeup, scheduler and diagnostic overhead; they are not isolated lock time. Inline ablation removes dispatch AND parallelism, so its net delta is not a pure synchronization percentage.

sample.trigger: first source Run in progress log
sample.limits: Sampling includes wall-time residence on parked threads; stack counts are not CPU percentages. Symbolication time is included in command end. Logging and sampling perturb this diagnostic.
